name: counterlane
description: Evidence-driven adaptive compute control for Codex across model, reasoning effort, speed tier, topology, and verification.

interface.shortDescription: Route Codex intelligence, depth, and speed
interface.longDescription: Counterlane selects the Codex model, reasoning effort, speed/service tier, execution topology, and verifier. Its self-falsifying controller can retain the control lane, route adaptively, compare paired counterfactual lanes, or abstain when evidence is insufficient.
defaultPrompt: Compare the adaptive lane against the static control lane.
Explain the model, effort, speed, topology, and proof choice.
